A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.24 
§ Pileha = "slicing"
a chief of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.9; 
son of: Raphu (H7505)
§ Palti or Phalti = "my deliverance"
1) son of Raphu, the spy chosen from the tribe of Benjamin
2) son of Laish, the man to whom king Saul gave his daughter Michal in marriage even though she was already married to David

Someone descended from Pelon or Palet(?), first mentioned at 2Sa.23.26; also called Paltite at 2Sa.23.26; 
Group of pe.lo.ni (פְּלוֹנִי "Pelonite" H6397) 
§ Paltite = "escape"
a descendant of Palti or an inhabitant of Beth-palet

A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.12.17 
§ Piltai = "my deliverances"
a priest, representative of the priestly house of Moadiah; an exile who returned with Zerubbabel

A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.26; 
son of: Azzan (H5821)
§ Paltiel or Phaltiel = "God delivers"
1) son of Azzan and prince of the tribe of Issachar appointed as one of the 12 to apportion the land of Canaan
2) son of Laish of Gallim to whom Saul gave Michal in marriage after his mad jealousy had driven David forth as an outlaw
